metadata.description: Iterative refinement of cohort analysis with multiple explicit corrections

turns.content: Give me a cohort analysis showing user retention by signup month for 2024.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create cohort retention table by signup month

turns.content: For retention, only count users who have been active in the last 30 days.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use last 30 days activity for retention definition

turns.content: Add a column showing the average MRR per cohort.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add average MRR calculation per cohort

turns.content: When I say 'signup month', I mean the account creation month, not subscription start. Use accounts.created_at.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm and use accounts.created_at

turns.content: Now add month-over-month retention rate change.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate MoM retention change

turns.content: Exclude trial accounts from all cohort analyses.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out trial plan tier

turns.content: Apply the same filters we've established to show me top 10 accounts by age.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: retained = last 30 days, use created_at, exclude trial

turns.content: Just to confirm — what filters are we currently applying?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all active filters

turns.content: Good. Now show me the same cohort analysis but for Enterprise accounts only.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter to Enterprise tier and re-run cohort analysis

turns.content: Show me the user count by cohort.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add user count to cohort data

turns.content: When analyzing subscription dates, always use subscription.start_date.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm and use subscription.start_date

turns.content: Let me see the average user count per account by cohort.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate users per account by cohort

turns.content: Which cohort has the best retention?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify best performing cohort

turns.content: Show me the account industry distribution by cohort.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show industry breakdown per cohort

turns.content: Remember the retention definition we established? Apply that to show active users by month.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use last 30 days activity definition

turns.content: What's the total MRR from the January 2024 cohort?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate January cohort MRR

turns.content: Create a chart showing cohort retention curves.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create cohort retention visualization

turns.content: What filters are currently active?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all active filters

turns.content: Show me the retention by plan tier within each cohort.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add plan tier dimension to cohort analysis

turns.content: What's the churn rate by cohort?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate churn rate per cohort

turns.content: Earlier we excluded trial accounts. What would the numbers look like if we included them?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show what trial accounts would contribute

turns.content: Keep trial accounts excluded. Show me the final cohort summary.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide comprehensive cohort summary

turns.content: Add feature adoption rate by cohort.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add feature adoption to cohort data

turns.content: What's the feature adoption rate by cohort?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate adoption percentage per cohort

turns.content: Apply all the corrections we've made to show me a final dashboard.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: last 30 days, use created_at, exclude trial, use subscription.start_date

turns.content: Create a chart showing cohort size over time.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create cohort size trend visualization

turns.content: Show me the growth rate by cohort.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate cohort growth rates

turns.content: Which cohorts are growing vs declining?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify growth trends

turns.content: What was the retention rate for the March 2024 cohort?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall March cohort retention

turns.content: Show me the top 10 cohorts by retention with all filters.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show cohort ranking with all filters

turns.content: Create a final summary chart.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create summary visualization

turns.content: Thank you. We've established that January and February 2024 cohorts have the best retention, with Enterprise tier showing stronger retention across all cohorts.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge findings

persistedCorrections.description: Use last 30 days activity for retention
Always use account creation date for signup

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Exclude trial accounts from all analyses

anaphoricReferences.expectedResolution: Last 30 days, use created_at, exclude trial
